children: “India’s growth story is filled with opportunities and the next generation workforce talent makes it a global destination for investment,” said R Shankar Raman, President & Wholetime Director- Finance of Larsen & Toubro.

Delivering the 40th Convocation Day address at SASTRA Deemed University, Thanjavur, on Saturday, Raman outlined Healthcare, Education, Public Transport & Utilities, Semiconductor, Water, Defence and Energy and Environment as strategic areas of investment that shall leverage the bountiful demographic dividend of India.

Raman said there must be a coordinated effort between industry and academia to provide a balance between grounded knowledge in traditional disciplines and continuous learning in emerging technologies.

While the first degree is for first job, continuous learning is for the last job, said Raman. He urged graduates to be mentally agile and adaptable to face emerging challenges and be an integral part of nation building which offers a bouquet of career opportunities.
A release said that 4,414 students were conferred with various UG, PG & Ph.D. degree in engineering, sciences, management, law, education and social sciences disciplines in the convocation.

The founder Chancellor’s Best Ph.D. thesis award was presented to three scholars — Dr Hari Suthan, Dr Anusree Sajeevan & Dr Satya M from Engineering, Sciences and non-STEM disciplines. The Lord Selvamuthukumaran Award for Overall Academic Excellence and the Silver Jubilee Alumni Award for the Best Outgoing Girl Graduate Student were both awarded to Biyyappu Hari Keerthi of the B.Tec. ECE degree programme, the release said.

title: India is a global investment destination: L&T President
